title: Physics GP-7: raycast, contact force, IMU, and debug overlay
body:
Port sensors and debug drawing (`sensors/contact_force_go2.py`, `sensors/imu_franka.py`, `sensors/lidar_teleop.py`, `tutorials/draw_debug.py`). Roadmap: `docs/physics/2026-09-27-genesis-port-roadmap.md`.

**Scope**
- `physics`: raycast against colliders with a filter; per-body contact force from last-step impulses; an IMU (specific force and body angular rate); debug primitives for contacts, normals, joint anchors, and thrust vectors.
- Lagrange: the HUD shows impact force, g-load, spin rate, and proximity. The Verse renderer can toggle a debug overlay.

**Accept**
- Sensor values match analytic cases (a thruster burn, a head-on collision, a ray against each shape).
- The overlay costs nothing when off.
